scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@relieve/shared && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/database && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/api && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/web
